{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Verify the count of such orders
count_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print the results
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders: {count_loyal_completed}')"}
